components.name: Metro Hero Live Tile
components.description: Flat 0px-radius Metro color-block live tile with geometric SVG glyph, monospace short-code stamp, bold lowercase title, and 4px solid white D-Pad focus ring.
components.css: .ds-metro-tile { position: relative; appearance: none; border: none; border-radius: 0px; background-color: #0078D7; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Work Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 22px; width: 320px; min-height: 210px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-metro-tile:hover { transform: scale(1.01); } .ds-metro-tile:focus, .ds-metro-tile:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; transform: scale(1.022); } .ds-tile-top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; } .ds-tile-glyph { width: 44px; height: 44px; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-code-stamp { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28); color: #FFFFFF; padding: 4px 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tile-bottom { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 100%; margin-top: 24px; } .ds-tile-title { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 1.05; text-transform: lowercase; } .ds-tile-edition { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tile-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Panorama Pivot Header
components.description: Giant ExtraLight (200) lowercase panorama section switcher rail on pure OLED black.
components.css: .ds-pivot-rail { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 32px; background-color: #000000; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #262626; } .ds-pivot-btn { appearance: none; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 0px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Work Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 200; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 0.95; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58); text-transform: lowercase; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-pivot-btn:hover { color: #D4D4D4; } .ds-pivot-btn[aria-selected="true"] { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-pivot-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 4px; color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Primary Metro Action Button
components.description: High-contrast 0px-radius rectangular command button with 2px solid white border that snaps to Metro Cobalt on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: 2px solid #FFFFFF; border-radius: 0px; padding: 12px 18px; background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; font-family: 'Work Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background-color: #0078D7; color: #FFFFFF; outline: 3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Short-Code Stamp Chip
components.description: Tabular-nums monospace short-code preset chip that inverts to Signal Emerald on hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-code-chip { appearance: none; background-color: #000000; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #454545; border-radius: 0px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; background-color: #107C10; display: inline-block; } .ds-code-chip:hover, .ds-code-chip:focus-visible { background-color: #107C10; border-color: #FFFFFF; outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-code-chip:hover .ds-chip-dot, .ds-code-chip:focus-visible .ds-chip-dot { background-color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Metro Command Input
components.description: Zero-radius pitch-black command or short-code input field with crisp white focus frame.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; background-color: #121212; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #262626; width: 280px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #8E8E8E; } .ds-input-field { appearance: none; background-color: #000000; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #454545; border-radius: 0px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input-field:hover { border-color: #D4D4D4; } .ds-input-field:focus, .ds-input-field:focus-visible { border-color: #FFFFFF; outline: 2px solid #0078D7; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Top Switcher Bar
components.description: Persistent top chrome bar with 12x12px Cobalt square emblem and bracketed monospace navigation links.

components.css: .ds-topbar { background-color: #0A0A0A; border-bottom: 1px solid #262626; padding: 8px 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #0078D7; display: inline-block; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #D4D4D4; text-decoration: none; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #FFFFFF; background-color: #121212; outline: none; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { background-color: #0078D7; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview:
kv-tv-theme is an unapologetically flat, razor-sharp 10-foot and desktop design system rooted in the Digital Design Canon of Windows Phone 7 / Zune HD Metro (digital-design-canon-metro-typographic-tiles). Rather than wrapping content in translucent glass panels, blurred backdrops, or rounded card chrome, the interface treats typography, flat high-chroma color planes, and pure OLED black void (#000000) as the sole structural materials. Oversized light-weight lowercase panorama pivot headers anchor the top of every stage, while asymmetric multi-span live tiles (2×2 hero, 2×1 wide, 1×1 square) carry crisp geometric vector glyphs, bottom-left bold lowercase titles, and monospace telemetry stamps.

Every surface is engineered simultaneously for a 10-foot living-room television navigated by a 5-way Android TV D-Pad remote (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Enter) and a high-density desktop browser or admin console. Focus is never ambiguous: active tiles snap forward (scale(1.022)) with a 4px solid white perimeter frame (outline: 4px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px) and zero blurred glow.

The system explicitly rejects all contemporary AI-slop tropes: no backdrop-filter: blur(), no radial neon glows, no rounded corners (border-radius: 0px everywhere), no gradient text or gradient tile backgrounds, and no decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Pure OLED pitch-black canvas (#000000) that turns off unlit television pixels and maximizes chromatic pop.

Giant light-weight (font-weight: 200) lowercase panorama pivot headers (store, pre-sets, short-codes, phone-qr, overview, applications, promotions) that establish hierarchy through scale and opacity contrast alone.
Unmodulated, high-chroma flat color-block tiles (cobalt, violet, teal, crimson, vermilion, emerald, amber) paired exclusively with crisp white ink (#FFFFFF).
Strict 0px corner radius across every tile, button, badge, modal dialog, table, and input control.
10-foot D-Pad spatial readiness with 4px solid #FFFFFF focus rings, 2D bounding-box roving tabindex, and tabular-nums monospace short-code stamps.

rules.name: The Unmodulated Color-Block Rule
rules.body: Every live tile and KPI block must use a single flat solid CSS color (background-color) with zero linear or radial gradients, zero internal drop shadows, and zero background photography bleed.

rules.name: The True OLED Pitch-Black Rule
rules.body: The root stage (html, body, .metro-grid) must always be pure #000000 so that the 12px grid gutters read as physical void between illuminated color planes on OLED television panels.

rules.name: The Brand-Locked Tile Color Rule
rules.body: Each flagship application and utility owns a permanent semantic tile color (cobalt for CloudStream 3, violet for Jellyfin TV, teal for Kodi 21, crimson for KV-Netflix, vermilion for KV-Tube, emerald for Short-Code Dialer, amber for Phone QR) that carries across the storefront, modal banners, and admin dashboards.

rules.name: The Lowercase Panorama Pivot Rule
rules.body: All panorama pivot headers (pivot-btn), tile titles (tile-title), and modal banner titles (dialog-title) must use text-transform: lowercase with tight negative tracking (-0.03em to -0.04em) to preserve the authentic Zune/Metro editorial voice.

rules.name: The 12px Functional Floor & Tabular-Nums Rule
rules.body: No text node anywhere in the interface may drop below 0.75rem (12px), and every numeric counter, short-code (88101–88105), version string, price, and file size must enforce font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: Never apply box-shadow, text-shadow, or backdrop-filter: blur() to any tile, modal, button, or navigation bar.

rules.name: The Crisp White Focus Frame Rule
rules.body: Every interactive tile and control must indicate :focus-visible with a solid, unblurred #FFFFFF outline (4px solid #FFFFFF with outline-offset: 2px on tiles; 2px or 3px solid #FFFFFF on buttons and inputs).

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: border-radius must remain 0px on every element without exception; pill badges, rounded avatars, and softened card corners are forbidden.

rules.name: The Structural Hairline Rule
rules.body: Internal tile metadata rows and secondary strips divide content with exposed 1px solid hairlines (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) inside color tiles; rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) on dark surfaces) rather than nested card boxes.

dos: Do keep the root viewport background at pure #000000 (oled-void) so the 12px live-tile gutters act as true unlit OLED black separation.
Do enforce border-radius: 0px (rounded.none) on every single element, including tiles, buttons, inputs, QR frames, badges, and <dialog> modals.

Do set all panorama pivot headers (font-weight: 200, clamp(2.8rem, 5vw, 4.6rem)) and live tile titles (font-weight: 700) in text-transform: lowercase with tight negative letter-spacing (-0.03em to -0.04em).
Do pair every Metro color block (#0078D7, #6B21A8, #008272, #D83B01, #B91C1C, #107C10, #B45309) with pure #FFFFFF text and vector icons to guarantee WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.8:1).
Do provide a 4px solid #FFFFFF focus outline (outline-offset: 2px) and transform: scale(1.022) on all focusable tiles so 10-foot Android TV D-Pad users can track focus effortlessly across the room.
Do apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (JetBrains Mono) to all 5-digit short-codes (88101–88105), install counters, file sizes, and version stamps.
donts: Don't use backdrop-filter: blur(), frosted glass overlays, or translucent floating cards anywhere in the interface.
Don't apply box-shadow, neon outer glows, or colored drop shadows to tiles, modals, or buttons.
Don't use linear, radial, or mesh gradients on tile backgrounds or typography; every color plane must be a single unmodulated solid color.
Don't introduce rounded corners (border-radius: 4px, 8px, 9999px) on pills, buttons, avatars, or dialogs.
Don't set any text smaller than 0.75rem (12px) or use low-contrast gray text inside saturated color tiles.
Don't trap keyboard or D-Pad users in 1D tab loops; always wire 2D spatial arrow-key navigation (.metro-grid) and native <dialog closedby="any"> Escape/Back dismissal.
